Find exact or closely matching reaction records and compare solvent-associated yields.'}

**Methanol (CO) is the evidence-supported choice in the retrieved records:** all 10 close matches used methanol, with yields from **73.2% to 78.1%**. A record using sodium hydroxide gave **73.2%**; another hydroxide-base record gave **76.3%**. The records were run at 100 °C for 5 hours.

No THF or DMF records appeared in the results, so the evidence does **not** establish that methanol is intrinsically better than those solvents. Nor did the matches include the requested dppf/iron-containing catalyst representation; they reported palladium acetate with phosphine ligands instead.
